summary: The change modifies Retention.java so that the legal-hold guard only applies to DECLINED cases, leaving WITHDRAWN cases under legal hold unprotected from NPI purging. This directly contradicts RET-1, which requires that NPI 'is never purged while a legal hold applies' regardless of case status. No exception in the register covers this deviation. All process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-7, EXC-1, LAP-1) are satisfied, but the product-obligation violation on RET-1 is unambiguous and unmitigated, requiring rejection.
